column1: 20365§reign§reɪn§Leo is an ambitious man, who wants to reign over the country.§里奥是一个有野心的人，他想要**统治**整个国家。§
20366§heritage§ˈherɪtɪdʒ§The highland games are part of Scotland's cultural heritage.§高地竞技是苏格兰文化**遗产**的一部分。§
20367§appropriate§əˈprəʊpriət§Personality questionnaires are used by many companies to put people in appropriate areas of work.§很多公司通过性格测试的方式把员工安排到**合适的**工作岗位上。§
20368§annual§ˈænjuəl§All students at the college are entitled to become members of the Sports Centre for an annual fee of $200.§在校大学生只需交200美元的**年**费，就可以成为运动中心的会员。§
20369§depict§dɪˈpɪkt§The photographs depicted vivid scenes of a young girl's life.§这些照片栩栩如生地**描绘**出一个年轻女孩的生活。§
20370§literacy§ˈlɪtərəsi§There is a great concern in many nations about declining standards of literacy in schools.§学校**文化教育**标准的降低令许多国家十分担心。§
20371§calculate§ˈkælkjuleɪt§It has been calculated that 17 percent of lung cancer cases can be attributed to high levels of exposure to second-hand tobacco smoke.§据**统计**，有17%的肺癌是由于长期处于二手烟环境而引起的。§
20372§luxury§ˈlʌkʃəri§He saved some money for luxuries such as fine paintings.§他积攒了一些钱，想买一些精品油画之类的**奢侈品**。§
20373§purchase§ˈpɜːtʃəs§If you'd like to purchase any of George's books or other souvenirs, leave the house by the side entrance.§如果你想**购买**乔治的书或其他纪念品，请从房子的侧门离开。§
20374§constant§ˈkɒnstənt§We need to have a constant supply of bikes to tourists.§我们需要**不断地**向游客提供自行车。§
20375§dormancy§ˈdɔːmənsi§That huge volcano erupted after one hundred years of dormancy.§在长达一百年的**休眠**之后，那座巨大的火山又喷发了。§
20376§particular§pəˈtɪkjələ(r)§Does the course have anything in particular?§这门课程有什么**特殊**之处吗？§改例句：has 应为 have（助动词 does 后用原形），并去掉问号前的空格
20377§subscription§səbˈskrɪpʃn§A statue in his memory was erected by public subscription.§由公众**捐资**建起一座纪念他的雕像。§
20378§pitch§pɪtʃ§The little device can give off a high pitched noise when you whistle.§当你吹口哨时，这个小装置就会发出**尖锐**刺耳的声音。§
20379§entitle§ɪnˈtaɪtl§As a member of the museum you would be entitled to use the members' lounge for refreshments.§作为博物馆的会员，你**有权**在会员休息室内享用茶点。§
20380§shutter§ˈʃʌtə(r)§In 1889 an improved model with a new shutter design was introduced, and it was called the No. 2 Kodak camera.§1889年推出的“柯达二号”是一款装有新型**快门**的改良型相机。§
20381§demolish§dɪˈmɒlɪʃ§Many of the buildings which were poorly designed and constructed have been demolished.§许多设计和建造粗糙的建筑物都被**拆除**了。§
20382§durable§ˈdjʊərəbl§The table shows the consumer durables (telephone, refrigerator, etc.) owned in Britain from 1972 to 1983.§该表格显示了从1972年到1983年英国**耐用**消费品（如电话、电冰箱等）的拥有情况。§改例句：英文句中的中文括号改为英文括号
20383§cope§kəʊp§Books are available to help employees cope with stress.§书籍有助于员工**应对**压力。§
20384§circulation§ˌsɜːkjəˈleɪʃn§Nicotine and other toxins in cigarette will affect blood circulation throughout the body.§香烟中的尼古丁和其他毒素会影响人体内的血液**循环**。§
20385§tradition§trəˈdɪʃn§Individuals often find it hard to escape from the role that cultural traditions have defined for them.§人们经常发现难以摆脱文化**传统**给自己限定的角色。§
20386§benefit§ˈbenɪfɪt§Increased leisure time would benefit two-career households.§增加休息时间会使双职工家庭**受益**。§
20387§decay§dɪˈkeɪ§The wooden bridge was unsafe due to decay.§这座木桥**腐烂**了，不安全。§
20388§distribution§ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn§A society can achieve a fair distribution of resources only under conditions of economic growth.§只有在经济增长的前提下，社会才可能对资源进行公平**分配**。§
20389§defect§ˈdiːfekt§Foetuses can be tested for genetic defects while in the womb.§胎儿还在子宫里时就可以通过检查看其是否存在基因**缺陷**。§
20390§oppose§əˈpəʊz§Some environmentalists have opposed economic development of any kind.§一些环保主义者**反对**任何形式的经济发展。§
20391§statistics§stəˈtɪstɪks§I'm quite interested in statistics about the schools in the different zones.§我对不同区域的学校的**统计资料**很感兴趣。§
20392§stuffy§ˈstʌfi§We've installed air conditioning, so it won't get so hot and stuffy.§我们安装了空调，因此不会太**闷**热。§
20393§approximately§əˈprɒksɪmətli§The next bus will come in approximately five minutes.§下一班公交车**大约**会在五分钟后到达。§
20394§excusable§ɪkˈskjuːzəbl§Absent-mindedness is an excusable human weakness.§心不在焉是人的一种**可以原谅的**缺点。§
20395§propose§prəˈpəʊz§I understand that Bob is familiar with Manchester Park and propose letting him show you around.§我知道鲍勃对曼彻斯特公园很熟，**建议**让他带你去逛逛。§改例句：propose 后接动名词，let 改为 letting
20396§ornament§ˈɔːnəmənt§The exhibition wall is covered with paintings and ornaments.§这面展示墙上挂满了油画和**装饰物**。§
20397§energetic§ˌenəˈdʒetɪk§I don't like doing energetic exercises in the evening.§我不喜欢在晚上做**剧烈**运动。§
20398§atmospheric§ˌætməsˈferɪk§The main reason for atmospheric pollution is the increase of carbon dioxide emissions.§**大气**污染的主要原因是二氧化碳排放量的增加。§改例句：reason of 应为 reason for
20399§cooperative§kəʊˈɒpərətɪv§The members in the club are very cooperative.§这个俱乐部的成员都非常**配合**。§
20400§corrode§kəˈrəʊd§Acid rain can corrode metal and stone work.§酸雨能**腐蚀**金属制品和石头制品。§
20401§honour§ˈɒnə(r)§The planet was for a time called Herschel in honour of its discoverer.§为了**纪念**这颗行星的发现者，它一度被称为赫舍尔星。§
20402§dislodge§dɪsˈlɒdʒ§The bear used a tree branch on multiple occasions to dislodge a piece of meat hung out of his reach.§熊多次用树枝**取下**挂在自己够不着的地方的肉。§
20403§soluble§ˈsɒljəbl§Fat soluble vitamins can be stored for quite some time in the body.§**能溶于**脂肪的维生素可在体内储存很久。§
20404§administration§ədˌmɪnɪˈstreɪʃn§The administration office is opposite the car park on the left.§**管理**办公室在停车场对面的左边。§
20405§environment§ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt§The one kind of subsidy whose removal appeared to have been bad for the environment was the subsidy to manage soil erosion.§取消对土地流失管理部门的补助金给**环境**带来了不利影响。§
20406§licence§ˈlaɪsns§They all have gone through a very tough training period to get a special taxi driving licence.§他们都经历了一段非常严格的训练才获得了专门的出租车驾驶**执照**。§
20407§underline§ˌʌndəˈlaɪn§You can underline new words encountered in your reading.§你可以在阅读中遇到的新单词下面**画线**做标记。§

20408§activate§ˈæktɪveɪt§Nicotine in cigarette smoke activates small blood cells that increase the likelihood of blood clots, thereby affecting blood circulation throughout the body.§香烟中的尼古丁会**激活**小的血细胞，这些血细胞增加了血栓的可能性，从而影响体内的血液循环。§
20409§major§ˈmeɪdʒə(r)§In Mexico city, vehicle pollution is a major health hazard.§在墨西哥城，交通污染是人们健康的一个**主要**威胁。§
20410§specific§spəˈsɪfɪk§Do you have any specific studying goals for this year?§今年你有**具体的**学习目标吗？§
20411§objective§əbˈdʒektɪv§The objective of the Human Genome Project is simple to state.§人类基因工程的**目标**很容易说明。§
20412§concentrate§ˈkɒnsntreɪt§The Ancient Greeks used lenses or concave mirrors to concentrate the sun's rays.§古希腊人利用透镜或凹面镜来**聚集**太阳光。§
20413§conflict§ˈkɒnflɪkt§Friction management means handling conflicts in a positive and constructive manner.§摩擦管理就是指用一种积极的、有建设性的方式来处理**冲突**。§
20414§antidote§ˈæntidəʊt§Researchers could not say for sure which medicine might be a successful antidote to bacterial infection.§研究人员不能确定哪种药可以有效地**治疗**细菌感染。§
20415§discover§dɪˈskʌvə(r)§Scientists are working to discover the links between the weather and people's moods and performance.§科学家正致力于通过研究来**发现**天气和人的情绪、行为之间的联系。§
20416§necessarily§ˌnesəˈserəli§As an international student you'll not necessarily be eligible for all the facilities offered to resident students.§作为国际学生，你不**一定**有资格享受当地学生享有的所有便利。§
20417§turret§ˈtʌrət§From the castle turret, people could oversee this beautiful river.§从城堡的**塔楼**上，人们可以俯瞰这条美丽的河流。§
20418§continent§ˈkɒntɪnənt§Australia is a dry continent, second only to Antarctic in its lack of rainfall.§澳大利亚是一片干燥的**大陆**，降水量之少仅次于南极洲，位居世界第二。§
20419§elastic§ɪˈlæstɪk§The ropes are made of elastic fabrics.§这些绳子是由**弹性**纤维制成的。§
20420§enhance§ɪnˈhɑːns§Organisations provide a range of opportunities for women to enhance their skills.§一些组织为妇女提供大量**提高**她们技能的机会。§
20421§demonstration§ˌdemənˈstreɪʃn§Thousands of people took part in the demonstration.§数千人参加了**示威游行**。§
20422§interrupt§ˌɪntəˈrʌpt§A: How does your headache affect your daily life? B: It has interrupted my work.§A: 头痛对你的日常生活有什么影响？B: 它**妨碍**到了我工作。§
20423§redundant§rɪˈdʌndənt§Jill was unlucky to be made redundant from her job.§吉尔不幸**被解雇**。§
20424§mishandle§ˌmɪsˈhændl§In our experience some types of exercise are easily mishandled and can lead to more harm than good.§根据我们的经验，一些锻炼很容易**操作不当**，进而弊大于利。§
20425§amend§əˈmend§The tutor told his student to amend the final edition of his paper and hand it in next Monday.§导师让他的学生再**修改**一下论文终稿，下周一上交。§改例句：hand in 缺宾语，补 it
20426§suppression§səˈpreʃn§The government's violent suppression of the protests was widely criticised by international human rights groups.§政府对抗议活动的暴力**镇压**受到了国际人权组织的广泛批评。§补例句
20427§mainly§ˈmeɪnli§The weather is mainly cold and wet in England.§英格兰的天气以阴冷**为主**。§
20428§property§ˈprɒpəti§Malleability is a physical property.§延展性是（物质的）一个物理**特性**。§
20429§naked§ˈneɪkɪd§The luminaries that can be seen by our naked eyes are quite a small part of the universe.§我们**肉**眼所能看到的天体仅仅是宇宙中很小的一部分。§
20430§feature§ˈfiːtʃə(r)§Asymmetry is a common feature of the human body.§不对称是人体的一个普遍**特征**。§
20431§lens§lenz§Lenses can be used to concentrate the sun's rays.§**透镜**可用来聚集太阳光。§
20432§coordinator§kəʊˈɔːdɪneɪtə(r)§He worked in the government as an economic development coordinator.§他在政府工作，是一名经济发展**协调员**。§
20433§nourish§ˈnʌrɪʃ§All the children were well nourished and in good physical condition.§所有这些孩子都**营养**良好，身体健康。§
20434§crisp§krɪsp§The answers from the soldiers are crisp and assured.§士兵们的回答**干脆**而肯定。§
20435§guilty§ˈgɪlti§The information can lead to the conviction of any person guilty of placing metal pieces in products.§这些信息可以将那些**犯有**把金属片放入产品中之罪的人绳之以法。§改译文：「非法」不是 guilty 的意思，改为「犯有…之罪」
